title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — Contraceptive and HRT (pseudonymised)
description: Minimally processed pseudonymised metadata (TCode instead of StudyID, shifted dates, PII removed, letter codes as numbers) from contraceptive_hrt.json containing Use of the contraceptive pill, other hormonal contraception, hormone replacement therapy (HRT) and other sex hormone treatments, collected at baseline.

R0_ContracepPillUse.title: Whether the participant has ever used the contraceptive pill
R0_ContracepPillUse.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No.

default: S02:p.17 Q6:1 Have you ever used “the pill”? Yes No

ContracepPill.title: Contraceptive pill episodes
ContracepPill.description: One entry per period of use of the contraceptive pill ("the pill"), up to 9, in the order reported; a pill stopped and re-started within 6 months is one episode (page 17). The first three are printed on page 17 and further ones go on page 15:1; more than three are flagged by R0_ContracepPill_MoreThanThree and more than nine by R0_ContracepPill_MoreThanNine.

default: S02:p.17 Q6:1 Have you ever used “the pill”?

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R026: the participant did not answer Yes to ever using the contraceptive pill (0 or 2), so the pill episodes are not asked and the 'more than 3 episodes' box is structurally not applicable -- ContracepPill is empty and R0_ContracepPill_MoreThanThree carries the missing-numeric sentinel. The dictionary's 'more than 9 episodes' box (R0_ContracepPill_MoreThanNine) is also not applicable. Questionnaire p.17 Q6:1: 'If no go to question 6:2'.

default: S02:p.17 Q6:1 If 'no' go to question 6:2

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R027: the participant did not answer Yes to ever using another type of hormonal contraception (0 or 2), so the episodes are not asked and the 'more than 2 episodes' box is structurally not applicable -- OtherContracep is empty and R0_OtherContracep_MoreThanTwo carries the missing-numeric sentinel. The dictionary's 'more than 5 episodes' box (R0_OtherContracep_MoreThan5) is also not applicable. Questionnaire p.18 Q6:2: 'If no, go to question 6:3'.

default: S02:p.18 Q6:2 If 'no', go to question 6:3

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R028: the participant did not answer Yes to ever having hormone replacement therapy (0 or 2), so the episodes, the 'more than 3 episodes' box and the hormone-level question are structurally not applicable -- HRT is empty and R0_HRT_MoreThanThree and R0_HRT_HrmnLevelsChecked carry the missing-numeric sentinel. The dictionary's 'more than 8 episodes' box (R0_HRT_MoreThanEight) is also not applicable. Questionnaire p.19 Q6:3: 'If no, go to question 6:5' (question 6:4 is skipped).

default: S02:p.19 Q6:3 If 'no', go to question 6:5

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R030: the participant did not answer Yes to having had other sex hormone treatment (0 or 2), so the episodes are not asked and both 'more than' boxes (more than 2, and the dictionary's more than 7) are structurally not applicable -- OtherSexHrmn is empty and R0_OtherSexHrmn_MoreThanTwo and R0_OtherSexHrmn_MoreSeven carry the missing-numeric sentinel. Questionnaire p.20 Q6:5: 'If yes, please give the name of the treatment or preparation'.

allOf.$comment: Pill name routing R032: in each pill episode where the participant ticks Cannot remember the name, no name is given, so R0_ContracepPill_Name must carry the missing-string sentinel. Questionnaire p.17 Q6:1: 'Name of pill ... Cannot remember'. It is written here, not in the episode's own allOf, to keep the contraceptive routings together.
